selection_basis: Only public README, metadata, tool names and documented commands consulted after detector was frozen. No implementation source inspected before target commits and exact tool calls were preregistered.
isolation: Exact public Git SHA in single-use GitHub Actions environment; all data synthetic and local; no remote services, credentials, production stores, upstream source patches, or user input.
outcome_policy: All three fixed cohorts remain in denominator even if unexecutable, tool missing, result incomplete or all obligations pass. The frozen product must not be tuned or repaired on holdout output. Harness-only corrections must be separately logged and preserve initial original run.
